quotes.author: Grant Spring
quotes.text: An incredible trip! Captain Danny was professional, extremely knowledgeable, and great with kids and families who aren’t experienced fishers. The entire experience was seamless from booking and getting back to the marina where Captain filleted and packaged our fish for us to take home and enjoy. Top notch chartering in Galveston, TX. The girls are already ready to go again. Two thumbs up!

quotes.author: Angus Collier
quotes.text: My wife and I had the most amazing time fishing with Captain Danny! This was the highlight of our road-trip through Texas. We will definitely be booking a fishing trip with him again. I’m hooked on catching Reds after the big one he put me on this evening. Thanks again Dan!

quotes.author: TXNative
quotes.text: Amazing company with a great crew and top notch gear. Boat was extremely well outfitted and all fishing gear was in excellent condition. The crew (Travis and Jason) went out of their way to ensure a great day was had by all. We chose to Jetty/Bay fish for reds, sheepshead, drum, shark, jack, etc, and everyone caught plenty. Highly recommend Just Cast for your chartering needs. Now that Red Snapper season is upon us, we are planning on heading back out; this time for a marathon run for Red Snapper, Grouper, etc. Best of the best right here.

Had the most amazing afternoon!!! Captain JT and Tyler were awesome. They put us in great places. We caught amazing fish! We’ve never done any fishing like this. They were exceptionally helpful; Sharing their knowledge and experience. We couldn’t have asked for a better day!!! I’d like to specifically thank Captain JT and the owners of Just Cast Charters for allowing us to share such a great day with our pup family.

I have been on a lot of fishing boats. Some were good, and some not so much. This was by far the best trip I have been on. The fishing was great , but the crew was equally as great. You could go out all day with these guys and if you didn't catch a fish it would still be a good time. These guys are just friends you haven't met yet. Looking forward to booking another trip.

I had a few trips with Capt Benny and did well. This last trip was a blast.I caught 3 oversize drum in 4 hours with a few other fish as well. Water was good light winds and a sunny day. I was using the best leaders around. Anglers Pro Leaders got me hooked up !

Booked a 4 hour Jetty fishing trip on 11/7/23 with Captain J.T. We had an amazing time and maxed out on Bull Drum in 2 hours. Caught a limit of big Sheephead. If you want an experienced Captain that will put you on the fish, then Captain J.T. Is the man!

Booked what essentially was a private charter and the service was phenomenal. It was my first time fishing and our Capitan, Tanner, was extremely friendly, patient and accommodating. We just had to show up and he handled the rest. We managed to catch quite a few sharks in early July here; our Capitan cleaned our catch for us back at the docks and gave us great cooking tips. I couldn't be more pleased with how this trip turned out, thanks for the great time!
